upheld.reason: The detector sees the cyclotomic product, but its index runs from one to the positive level r stipulated by the defining presentation. The smallest admissible level is one, whose monic polynomial has degree one and quotient basis {1} by proof step 2.1; level zero and an empty root product are outside this Statement.
